reviews.t: Not as hard to use as I thought.
reviews.x: I’m still pretty new at this whole nail dip thing but I’m happy to say it isn’t as hard as I thought it would be. I recently cut my nails so my hands look like shreks hands but even with super short nails the dip is easy to apply. The bottles are all filled generously and they’re bigger than some others I’ve purchased through other sites.  I was missing the extras this is supposed to come with but hopefully I’ll get those soon as I just reached out to the CS team.  I’m super happy with the resul

I am returning this! My friend got one and I loved it. I ordered this one because I liked the colors. With her double dip she got actual real size dip containers like in the nail salon (she ordered from double dip) the containers i got were so small it was like it was for a child! So unhappy and mislead.
I Love these powders! They're easy to use. So soft and the colors are spectacular. The liquids go on so smooth and are easy to use. I used Enchanted and clear on my nails in the pic with a white tip.
I only use these liquids since they're easy to use. Lasts a long time!

These really work nicely and look and feel great.  They came off easy too and I am able to have tough, strong nails now that look good and I can do at home without the hassle of going to an expensive (and now 100% closed) nail salon.  I am thrilled with my purchase.

reviews.t: difficult to do the dominate hand
reviews.x: I liked that the kit had almost everything needed to apply a set on natural nails.  The video  was  somewhat helpful.  I had to search a bit to find some  help for applying over tips.  And even though I performed every step according to the videos, I had issues with the tips snapping off with the  minimum amount of pressure. Even after applying several coats of the gel powder.  As a former professional nail tech, I could do my  non-dominate hand fairly easily with  satisfactory results,  I just

reviews.t: Easy to use and I loved the results
reviews.x: For my first time using dip powder, I thought it was easy and straightforward. I did use my own set of nail files, but I think the one that came with the kit would be fine. I used three layers of fairy cotton, filed the shape, then I added o e layer of Enchanted. I will be reordering from this company.

Color pay off is terrible, colors are not pretty. They lift within 2 or 3 days, and the brushes get ruined after 1 or 2 uses. I don't recommend this item. When I tried to return them I was told I had to pay a percentage in order to return the items.

reviews.t: Great Salon look done at home!!!!
reviews.x: I absolutely love this product very easy instructions with great salon effect look.  I would suggest everyone to purchase this you wont be disappointed.  Very safe no uv light required fast drying I just love it😊

reviews.t: You get w they want you to get
reviews.x: I received 3 powders of the same color and 1 red. Very disappointed. If you don't have it, then give that info.

reviews.t: Not worth the money! Cheap quality.
reviews.x: The dip colors are all great basic colors. However, the base is pretty much nail glue so it smells just like it and it gets all thick and sticky after you do the first few nails. When you close it .. it’s hard to open again as the glue dries around the bottle and inside the handle. It applied super thick and left holes making the coats bumpy and uneven as well and was super frustrating trying to buff it and file it to be even. So I bought another brand of the base coat from Sally’s by GELISH and

reviews.t: Would only recommend if you know what you’re doing
reviews.x: This is the second dip powder kit I’ve tried. FYI I own a lot of extra buffing blocks and a nail drill that I bought separately.  Pros: -comes in glass jars. These liquids are strong chemicals that get sticky, etc. so glass is durable. I’ve had plastic jars of this stuff that get stuck together and crack -comes with extra brush heads and cuticle oil -instructions are easy  Cons: - doesn’t come with clear dip powder base coat even though instructions says to use it?? -the colors stain. My friend

I'M SO DISAPPOINTED IN THIS KIT. I just recieved this today and I'm seriously considering sending this back. I paid about 40 dollars for this kit. It was suppose to come with 5 brushes, cuticle remover, a buffer and file. It only came with the things pictured above. One of the bottles with the white top doesn't have a label on it. I feel like my kit was just thrown together. I was suppose to use this for my a wedding. I'm very unhappy. Will not purchase this again. So buyer beware, what you see

I cannot say enough great things about double dip! Their starter kits are of excellent quality and their customer service and the support and tips they provide have made this a successful new hobby of mine and definitely in the long run will save me money because I can do my own nails!  I have done a few applications so far in the last month or so and each time I am noticing improvement! Definitely a great product and company that I will be continuing to buy from and support!

So far so good! It’s easy to use, not too thick, and the top coat is shiny. Love that it’s made in the USA! The post office lost the package for a couple weeks and Allure Beauty offered to replace it if the post office didn’t locate it. Then when I got the package, there wasn’t any cuticle oil there was a brush cleaner instead. I contacted the company and they told me to keep the brush cleaner and they’re sending me a cuticle oil for free. Amazing customer service!

This is a great dipping system, but I will say that I have not been able to use the top coat. Unfortunately, with wiping off the excess activator with a lint free wipe didn’t solve this issue. The brush harden immediately! It had streaks too. I used a gel top coat that I cured with a UV lamp. If you are doing this step only use activator once. I also smooth the powder with a drill. Hope this helps! So far I love it.

The light pink in all of these mani's are from Double Dip. From the first mani to the most recent. I love the color so much. Powders are nice and fluffy. More importantly is the amazing liquids. They set the tone of how good the mani turns out. Since starting out in early May, I have tried a few different liquids and the Douple Dip liquids are my absolute favorite!! 5 stars all the way!!!!

The light pink in all of these mani's are from Double Dip. From the first mani to the most recent. I love the color so much. Powders are nice and fluffy. More importantly is the amazing liquids. They set the tone of how good the mani turns out. Since starting out in early May, I have tried a few different liquids and the Douple Dip liquids are my absolute favorite!! 5 stars all the way!!!!

I've been using a different starter set for a year and just had a friend recommend this one and it is so much easier to use!! I would spend so much time trying to get all the bumps and everything else smoothed out. I barely even had to do that with this one. I am beyond satisfied with this set and can't wait to buy more colors of dip powder. Perfect for beginners like me!

This is my first time using a product like this. I followed the directions completely. I chose red for my first time which was a mistake on my part due to the messiness. I liked the final result. However, it chipped after only a few hours. I fixed that finger that night. Then after one day, another nail chipped horribly. Very disappointed at how the product held up.

I love the dipping powders - this brand is particularly good. The liquid 1-2-3 lasts quite a long time. My only criticism is the red color can stain your hands and anything around where you are doing your nails. So just be aware of that.  Otherwise, tremendous way to save money as opposed to salon.

Just started to use this dip nail kit, my daughter introduced me to it. It was quick and easy to use, dries fast and lasts over a week or more. Love the colors and video on how to use are very helpful as well. I would highly recommend this to anyone that wants to save money and do their own nails.

First of all this came PACKAGED beautifully!! The products come in a cute little bag. Made gift giving great for my niece who loves doing her own nails. She is very savy on all nail products and really loves the quality of this one. Ahe is recommending to her friends!

This is my first time using dip, but this kit is well laid out for the newbie. They include scan code that take you to YouTube video tutorials and written instructions as well.  My first set wasn’t perfect, but I’m sure once I keep practicing, I’ll get better.

Used it once so far! Found out you DONT need the clear coat powder. It helps with the smoothness, but you can also fix any bumps with a file. The how to video was very helpful! So far, im very satisfied 😌  will definitely be buying other colors of thr powder!!

claims.text: Many reviewers find the dip powder easy to use, especially for beginners, and praise the results.
Several reviewers complain about quality and value issues, including small or wrong-sized containers, poor color payoff, lifting, and sticky liquids.
Some reviewers report missing or incomplete kit contents compared to what was advertised.
A few reviewers note the product is difficult to apply on the dominant hand or requires prior experience.
Some reviewers praise the customer service and company support.
